item.title: 'When She Touch Yo Stingaling' Meme Revives 2024 'FNAF' Meme Format
item.description: When She Touch Yo Dingaling is an image macro meme format where variations of the phrase, "When she touch yo dingaling" are paired with images of a subject expressing shock or a stoic, flat emotion. The original meme uses an image of Freddy Fazbear from Five Nights at Freddy's, purportedly taken from a FNAF Ransomware Retake video. item.title: 'Boys Wear It Daily' Riddle Goes Viral As Social Media Users Try And Figure Out The Right Answer
item.description: Boys Wear It Daily, Girls Wear It Once A Year is a riddle that asks what is one thing that boys wear daily, but girls wear only once a year. The riddle started circulating online as early as 2015 and went viral several times over the following years, including in late 2025. Multiple answers have been given for the riddle, including "the letter 'Y,'" as "Y" appears twice in the phrase "boys wear it daily" but only once in "girls wear it once a year." item.title: 1980s Commercial Featuring The Line 'Gimme A Cheese With Nothin' Becomes Source For Animation Memes Decades Later
item.description: Gimme A Cheese With Nothin' is a catchphrase and exploitable format taken from a commercial for Polly-O String Cheese from the 1980s, which later became a meme in 2023. The line has been used as an exploitable that adds various text to screencaps from the original commercial, and has also been used to make fan reanimations of the commercial.
